content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Understanding Bitcoin payments for digital downloads is crucial for creators seeking independence from conventional platforms. Bitcoin allows for instant transactions, eliminating the need for a third-party payment processor. Unlike platforms such as Gumroad, which charges a hefty 10% on every sale, utilizing NOWPayments allows you to retain a mere 0.5% fee. This means more revenue stays in your pocket, which can be significant—consider that with 100 sales per month at $97 each, you would save $921 in fees compared to using a platform like Gumroad. This cost efficiency empowers creators to reinvest in their business.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for processing Bitcoin payments involves various components that work seamlessly together. COREMERCH provides a sovereign digital commerce stack that includes hosting through GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, processing logic via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. When a customer makes a payment, NOWPayments ensures the transaction is confirmed on-chain with minimal fees. This architecture not only facilitates automated delivery of digital products but also guarantees full ownership and control over your data, setting the stage for a truly independent digital business.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela, where traditional payment processors are either unavailable or severely restricted. If you're a creator selling ebooks, courses, or software, this solution provides you with the necessary tools to set up an independent online store. The complete ownership model means that once your store is set up, you are not dependent on any platform. This sovereignty allows you to focus on creating rather than worrying about payment processing hurdles.
Save up to 10% on fees compared to platforms like Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of the sovereign digital commerce stack include several critical elements. First, you have the hosting service, which is free via GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. The backend processing is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which offers the necessary logic for transactions. For order storage, you can use Supabase or Google Sheets, providing an easy way to track sales and manage inventory. Finally, NOWPayments facilitates the Bitcoin transactions, ensuring that payments are received quickly and securely. Together, these components create a cohesive and efficient system for selling digital products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To leverage this infrastructure for your digital products, start by choosing the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH. Follow the deployment instructions provided in the Complete Builder Kit to set up your online store. Once your store is live, integrate NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin transactions seamlessly. Use the documentation to automate your product delivery through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Finally, monitor your sales through Supabase or Google Sheets to manage your digital assets efficiently. This straightforward approach positions you for success in the digital marketplace.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize Bitcoin payments through NOWPayments. By setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can accept payments directly in Bitcoin, ensuring low transaction fees and immediate payment confirmation. This gives you greater control over your sales without relying on conventional platforms.
Take control of your digital sales with complete ownership.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in selling digital products without the constraints of platforms like Gumroad, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit for $197. It provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to establish your sovereign digital commerce stack. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
